---
title: "Roshni Ko Hussain Kehte Hain"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Raqib"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Aa Gahi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.

1
Jis Ka Aashiq Hai Khaliq-e-Akbar.
Oss Sakhi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.
Charh Ke Naize Pe Jo Kalam Kare.
Bas Ossi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.
Khushboein Keh Rahi Hain Pholon Se.
Tazgi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.

2
Sheh Ke Gham Mein Jo Ro Ke Ho Mehsos.
Oss Khushi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.
De Do Fatwa Moinuddin Pe Jo.
Dein Hi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.
Maut Ne Kar Liya Hai Tay Raqib.
Zindagi Ko Hussain Kehte Hain.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/roshni-ko-hussain-kehte-hain-tajpoints-78736727dd648e71300e.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '12'), (body, '۱۲')]:
    opening, first, second = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(opening.splitlines()) == 1
    for stanza, number in zip((first, second), numbers):
        lines = stanza.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == number and len(lines) == 7
        assert all(not line.endswith('.') for line in lines)
assert 'noUrdu' not in metadata and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata
print('Both editions have one opening verse and two six-verse stanzas.')
PY"
